decisions.reason: The beige lettering applies specifically to the cursive E button markings; it does not change the existing beige primary finish or green accent colors.
Changing the button-marking lettering color does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The source concerns cursive E lettering on buttons, not the branded placard's text, position, orientation, or display sides.
The beige button lettering does not change the support base graphics or its reference-matched font color.
The source changes lettering on the machine's buttons and does not modify the support base's beige finish.
Button lettering color does not change the solenoid actuation mechanism or press-and-release dispensing behavior.
The source does not change the requirement for a dedicated machine power button or its control behavior.
The button-marking color has no necessary effect on the spout's rendered appearance, material, or fabrication method.
Button lettering color does not affect bowl depth, capacity, geometry, or refill expectations.
The visual treatment of button lettering does not affect bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The lettering-color decision does not change any matcha mixing, foam, texture, or high-speed behavior.
The source concerns only button lettering color and does not modify pour control, flow, dispensing path, or beverage preservation.
